kind: a Swiss village's summer pasture, forest and irrigation
one_line: A village above the Visp valley whose written articles of association are dated 1483 and whose cattle still go up in June.
insider_rationale: elected to run the alp this season
monitor_rationale: counts the herd onto the alp this season; four months, then somebody else does

ladder.label: marked-trees
ladder.text: Timber is cut only from trees the village has marked, and only in the season the village opens.

shared.label: village-purchase
shared.text: Anything bought for the village is agreed before it is bought.

access.label: citizens-only
access.text: Only a citizen of the village may hold a share in the alp, the forest or the waste.

inner_a.label: wintered-cattle
inner_a.text: Nobody sends more cows to the alp than the same household wintered on its own hay.

inner_b.label: cheese-by-share
inner_b.text: Cheese from the alp is divided by the cows each household sent.

clash_a.label: one-herd
clash_a.text: The village goes up as one herd, on the day the village names.

clash_b.label: high-snow-waits
clash_b.text: A household whose meadow is still under snow does not lose its turn.

extra.label: bell-order
extra.text: The lead cow is the one the herders agree on at the gathering.

policy.root: The village decides by consent: one reasoned objection stops a thing, and saying nothing is not an objection. Changing an article takes the assembly, and anything that cannot be undone is not decided by silence.
policy.inner: Whoever is elected to run the alp decides the alp.
policy.unheld: The quarry is decided by whoever holds it.
policy.ladder: The first time the village asks. The second time the assembly asks together. The third time the answer is no.
policy.inner_amended: Two of us have to object before an alp decision stops.

inner_proposal.text: count the herd at the gate on the day rather than off the winter hay
inner_proposal.because: the count at the gate is the number the alp actually carries

inner_objection: the winter hay is the whole point: it ties what you may graze in summer to what you can feed in winter, and a gate count cuts that tie

unheld_proposal.text: open the old quarry for building stone again

monitor_watch.about: a load of timber from an unmarked stand
monitor_watch.because: the stand was not marked and the season is not open
monitor_watch.dismissal: these two do not really conflict

ladder_subject.about: cutting timber outside the marked stand
ladder_subject.first: take a load from the unmarked stand to re-roof a barn
ladder_subject.second: take a second load from the unmarked stand for the same barn
ladder_subject.third: take the winter's firewood from the unmarked stand
ladder_subject.because: the marking is how the village keeps a forest that will still hold the slope above the houses
ladder_subject.ruling_1: the barn roof was open to the weather and we let it stand
ladder_subject.ruling_2: the assembly agreed one more, then no more

other_subject.about: grazing the waste before the alp opens
other_subject.text: graze the waste land in May before the alp opens

clash.about: going up on the named day
clash.text: let the two highest households follow a week after the herd when their meadows are still under snow
clash.because_a: a herd that goes up in pieces is a herd nobody can count and a pasture eaten unevenly
clash.because_b: a household that must go up on the named day with no hay left is a household that sells its cows
clash.carried: two households are above the treeline and the snow line moves; carrying it costs one uneven week and the alternative costs the village two herds, which is why it has a date on it

amend_convention.text: let the household with the most cows name the lead cow
amend_convention.because: the gathering argument takes longer than the walk up does

amend_principle.text: let any household follow within a week of the named day
amend_principle.because: the count can be taken on the alp as easily as at the gate

irreversible.text: pull down the high hut and use the timber on the lower one

silence.about: who takes the first watch on the alp
silence.rationale: it has fallen to whoever is already up there for two generations, and naming it would make it a duty somebody could be short of
silence.proposal: set a watch rota for the alp season

panel.rationale: three of us to look at the going-up rule for a month

not_applicable.2: There is no upstream. The articles were written here in 1483 and this canon was founded rather than forked, so there is no divergence from anywhere to make visible — the congruence is total and unmeasurable by this criterion.
not_applicable.7: Nothing upstream can undermine a commons that has no upstream. The criterion asks whether local commitments survive an upstream release; there is no upstream to release anything.
